Calculate GDP per sector with land productivity and land requirement coefficients

calculate_gdp.Rd

Computes GDP, output, land requirement, Land Requirement Coefficient (LRC), and Land Productivity Coefficient (LPC) for each sector.

Usage

calculate_gdp(
  added_value_m,
  intermediate_consumption_m,
  final_demand_m,
  sector,
  land_proportion,
  landuse_table,
  leontief
)

Arguments

added_value_m

Numeric matrix of added value.

intermediate_consumption_m

Numeric matrix of intermediate consumption.

final_demand_m

Numeric matrix of final demand.

sector

A data frame or tibble with at least two columns: sector name and category.

land_proportion

Numeric matrix of land proportions (Sector x Land Cover).

landuse_table

Data frame or tibble with an `area` column representing land area in hectares.

leontief

Numeric Leontief inverse matrix.

Value

A tibble with columns: SECTOR, CATEGORY, GDP, OUTPUT, Land_Requirement, LRC, LPC, GDP_PROP, FD, Prop_FD, Total_OUTPUT.

Details

Land Requirement Coefficient (LRC) and Land Productivity Coefficient (LPC) follow Hubacek & Sun (2001):

$$LRC_i = \frac{Land_i}{X_i}$$ $$LPC_i = \frac{1}{LRC_i} = \frac{X_i}{Land_i}$$

where \(X_i\) is total sectoral output and \(Land_i\) is total land requirement of sector i.

References

Hubacek, K., & Sun, L. (2001). A scenario analysis of China's land use and land cover change: incorporating biophysical information into input-output modeling. Structural Change and Economic Dynamics, 12(4), 367–397.
